newsitem.title: USA: BPA out of peak power market for Friday delivery.
newsitem.headline: BPA out of peak power market for Friday delivery.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Thursday it was not offering electricity for peak hour delivery Friday, while its price offers for light-load hours remained unchanged.
Offers of unlimited peak firm power during light load hours on Friday remained unchanged at $9.00 a megawatt hour (MWh).
Friday non-firm power from hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.

No peak power was offered, however, compared with prior offers for Thursday deliveries of 300 megawatts of peak firm power at $13.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and at $14.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
